title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha: The MOVIE 2nd A's Mini Picture Drama
justification: AniList 108549 has 2 episodes, both 2013-03-22 (synonyms 'Nanoha Picture Drama 02: Nurse Girl Medical Shamal - Prelude' and '03: Magical Family Wolken - Prelude'). AniDB 8821 (PARENT per AniList 10153) S1 'Mini Picture Drama: Magical Family Lyrical Wolken' and S2 'Mini Picture Drama: Nurse Girl Medical Shamal', both 2013-03-22; S3 'Anime Contents Expo 2012' (2012-04-01) is another item. TVDB 81115 0x21 '...Mini Picture Drama ~Magical Family Lyrical Wolken~' and 0x22 '...~Nurse Girl Medical Shamal~', both 2013-03-22; the overlay entry for 8821 places S1/S2 there by title (upstream defaults 0x01/0x02 are Triangle Heart episodes). The pair is proven by titles and date; what no source states is AniList's episode order. MAL lists the Shamal drama first in its synonyms (numbered 02) and Wolken second (03), the reverse of AniDB and TVDB; a bridge pairs AniList episode i with special i and cannot reorder, so episode 1/2 may be swapped. Medium for that reason only.
